scripts.preview: opennextjs-cloudflare build -c cloudflare/app-worker/wrangler.jsonc --skipWranglerConfigCheck && rm -rf ../../.open-next && mv .open-next ../../.open-next && opennextjs-cloudflare preview -c cloudflare/app-worker/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy: opennextjs-cloudflare build -c cloudflare/app-worker/wrangler.jsonc --skipWranglerConfigCheck && rm -rf ../../.open-next && mv .open-next ../../.open-next && opennextjs-cloudflare deploy -c cloudflare/app-worker/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply template-db --local --config cloudflare/app-worker/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply template-db --remote --config cloudflare/app-worker/wrangler.jsonc
